property_summary: For any caller address X and any new owner address Y, only the deployer-admin (the address that constructed C) can change owner via setOwner; the mutant that removes the onlyAdmin check allows non-admin callers to change owner, so there exist inputs (caller != admin) where owner differs.

For all callers and target owner addresses, only the deploying admin can successfully change C.owner via setOwner; the mutant that removes the onlyAdmin check allows a non-admin caller to change owner for some inputs (caller != admin and newOwner arbitrary).
